items.question: What is the FY2019 cash conversion cycle (CCC) for General Mills? CCC is defined as: DIO + DSO - DPO. DIO is defined as: 365 * (average inventory between FY2018 and FY2019) / (FY2019 COGS). DSO is defined as: 365 * (average accounts receivable between FY2018 and FY2019) / (FY2019 Revenue). DPO is defined as: 365 * (average accounts payable between FY2018 and FY2019) / (FY2019 COGS + change in inventory between FY2018 and FY2019). Round your answer to two decimal places. Address the question by using the line items and information shown within the income statement and the balance sheet.
items.answer: For General Mills in fiscal year 2019, cost of sales was 11,108.4 million dollars, net sales were 16,865.2 million dollars, ending inventory for FY2018 was 1,642.2 million dollars, ending inventory for FY2019 was 1,559.3 million dollars, receivables at FY2018 were 1,684.2 million dollars, receivables at FY2019 were 1,679.7 million dollars, accounts payable at FY2018 were 2,746.2 million dollars, and accounts payable at FY2019 were 2,854.1 million dollars. [1][2] The average inventory between FY2018 and FY2019 was (1642.2 + 1559.3) / 2 = 1600.75 million dollars, giving a days inventory outstanding (DIO) of 365 * 1600.75 / 11108.4 = 52.60 days. [1][2] The average accounts receivable between FY2018 and FY2019 was (1684.2 + 1679.7) / 2 = 1681.95 million dollars, giving a days sales outstanding (DSO) of 365 * 1681.95 / 16865.2 = 36.40 days. [1][2] The average accounts payable between FY2018 and FY2019 was (2746.2 + 2854.1) / 2 = 2800.15 million dollars, the change in inventory between FY2018 and FY2019 was 1559.3 - 1642.2 = -82.9 million dollars, and the days payables outstanding (DPO) was 365 * 2800.15 / (11108.4 + (1559.3 - 1642.2)) = 92.59 days, resulting in a cash conversion cycle of -3.70 days.
